description: Build order pour faire Age 3 rapide et prendre un avantage - via les BO de Jeando
name: [FR] RUS - Age 3 Rapide - par Jeando
author: Twister

notes: 2 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ =>@abilities/repair.webp@ 2 @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ si Civ qui aggro alors mettre sous TC ; Sinon greed le max de gold ; Rallye du TC sur @resource/sheep.webp@
Ramener les vil sur @resource/sheep.webp@ ; Faire un 2e @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ pour scout et ramener des moutons
Faire des vil en boucle avec rallye sur @resource/sheep.webp@ jusqu'à @age/age_2.webp@

8 vil pour @abilities/repair.webp@ 1 @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ sur un @resource/deer.webp@ / @resource/boar.webp@ + source de @resource/resource_wood.webp@pas loin - sinon sur @resource/resource_gold.webp@ + @resource/resource_wood.webp@ // Mettre le rallye TC sur @resource/resource_wood.webp@
Garder les 8 vil pour récolter et construire à côté du Kremlin
@abilities/repair.webp@ 1 @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ à côté de @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ pour récolter les cerfs // ne pas oublier @building_economy/house.webp@

lorsque les @resource/deer.webp@ / @resource/boar.webp@ sont setup mettre les vil près de TC sur bois sauf 1 sur mouton puis mettre le rally du TC sur@resource/resource_wood.webp@ jusqu'à 10 vil ; ensuite remettre sur @resource/deer.webp@
Une fois que les @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ proche TC sont finis, faire un @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ près du @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ avec les 10 vills

Ensuite lorsqu'on a assez de @resource/resource_wood.webp@ faire 1 @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@ et 1 @building_economy/mining-camp.webp@ près de @resource/resource_gold.webp@ pour @age/age_3.webp@

si besoin de construire, utiliser les vil qui sont au @resource/resource_wood.webp@ // faire @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@ ainsi que 2 @building_military/archery-range.webp@ lorsque possible
faire @landmark_rus/abbey-of-the-trinity.webp@ pour moines guerriers et arriver à avoir 2 @building_military/archery-range.webp@
Faire des @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@ & @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ en continu / Lorsqu'on a un peu de gold, faire des technos

Rallye TC à la @resource/resource_food.webp@ jusqu'à 15 puis les mettre au @resource/resource_wood.webp@ pour récupérer d'autres sources de @resource/deer.webp@ / @resource/boar.webp@ / @resource/berrybush.webp@

Ajouter @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ et@technology_military/steeled-arrow.webp@ @technology_military/balanced-projectiles.webp@ @technology_rus/boyars-fortitude.webp@ @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@@technology_military/wedge-rivets.webp@; Aller chercher les @resource/relics.webp@ sur la carte
Pour le reste de la partie : Si l'ennemi aggro => se défendre ; Sinon poser un 2e @building_economy/town-center.webp@ et faire une game macro
Ensuite on peut swap sur n'importe quelle compo d'armées

notes: Start pulling @unit_worker/villager.webp@off @resource/resource_gold.webp@once you get passive income from @landmark_rus/high-trade-house.webp@or @resource/relics.webp@
Pull @resource/resource_wood.webp@@unit_worker/villager.webp@and make @building_economy/farm.webp@, mass units win win @civilization_flag/rus.webp@@civilization_flag/rus.webp@

description: This is the newly updated Beastyqt's Rus build order for Pro Scouting into Fast Castle for season 11.
name: Rus Pro Scout into Fast Castle (Beasty)
author: Thoren

notes: 5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ to get 50 @resource/resource_wood.webp@ from @resource/gaiatreeprototypetree.webp@ and 1 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@and @building_economy/house.webp@ on woodline
5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to @resource/sheep.webp@ and 1 new @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ on the other side of the woods
Add @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ to 8 and @resource/rally.webp@ back to @resource/resource_food.webp@

Sell @resource/resource_food.webp@ or @resource/resource_wood.webp@ at @landmark_rus/the-golden-gate.webp@ to research @technology_economy/professional-scouts.webp@ and produce @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ from other @building_rus/hunting-cabin.webp@ untill 6/7 total.

If opponent is making @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to prevent you from Pro Scouting, @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/archery-range.webp@ and make couple @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ to escort scouts.

If opponent is making @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@ or @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@, @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/barracks.webp@ and make couple @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ to escort scouts.
Bring back @resource/deer.webp@ with your @unit_cavalry/scout.webp@ and research @technology_economy/survival-techniques.webp@

Build @building_rus/wooden-fortress.webp@ near @building_economy/lumber-camp.webp@ and switch @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @resource/sheep.webp@ to @resource/deer.webp@ when deer arrive under @building_economy/town-center.webp@

@landmark_rus/the-golden-gate.webp@ sell @resource/resource_wood.webp@ for @resource/resource_gold.webp@ , then 8@resource/resource_food.webp@ @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build @landmark_rus/high-trade-house.webp@ near safe woodline

Leave 8 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_food.webp@ and @resource/rally.webp@ to @resource/resource_wood.webp@ and get @technology_economy/double-broadaxe.webp@ and @technology_economy/wheelbarrow.webp@ as you're ageing up.

@abilities/repair.webp@@building_religious/monastery.webp@ and 2 more @building_military/archery-range.webp@ start producing @unit_rus/horse-archer-3.webp@ and some @unit_rus/warrior-monk.webp@ to get @resource/relics.webp@

If opponent is going all-in, @abilities/repair.webp@ @building_military/barracks.webp@ and @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ and produce @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@ and get @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@
If opponent has a lot of archers and ranged units, get @unit_cavalry/horseman-1.webp@
If opponent has a diverse army, get @unit_cavalry/knight-2.webp@
If your opponent has a lot of spearman, get @unit_infantry/man-at-arms-1.webp@
If your opponent has a lot of cavalry, get @unit_infantry/spearman-1.webp@ and/or @unit_infantry/crossbowman-3.webp@

description: Use two early Hunting Cabins, protect a strong food source with the Kremlin, make between zero and four Early Knights, then reach Castle Age around 8:30–8:40. Secure relics and Sacred Sites with Warrior Monks, mass the appropriate ranged unit, and overwhelm the opponent with Levy Militia plus the Warrior Monk blessing.
name: Rus 1TC Kremlin → Abbey Fast Castle
author: DrewCarryMore

notes: 0–2 if the opponent is completely safe
4 can raid as two groups of two
As we are @resource/rally.webp@@resource/resource_wood.webp@ rest of game, keep ~15 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ on @resource/resource_wood.webp@ put rest on a @resource/resource_food.webp@ source
Take @resource/relics.webp@ and @resource/sacred_sites.webp@, when enough passive @resource/resource_gold.webp@, move @unit_worker/villager.webp@ off @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Overbuild @building_economy/house.webp@ to levy all militia from @landmark_rus/kremlin.webp@ and go attack
5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@from @resource/sheep.png@ build @landmark_rus/kremlin.png@ ( Try to protect @resource/resource_wood.png@ and other resources)
5 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ from @landmark_rus/kremlin.png@ build @building_economy/lumber-camp.png@ near and move to @resource/resource_wood.png@
9 @unit_worker/villager.webp@ build 2nd @building_economy/town-center.png@ (find good location for TC (deer, boar, mines etc) don't put it too forward) )
